text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and understand text, so they can find useful information in emails, articles, or social media posts. NLP is also used in translation, helping people communicate across different languages quickly and easily. Another common use is sentiment analysis, which shows whether a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, NLP powers chatbots, which can answer questions and talk with customers online. Thanks to NLP, computers can work with human language in helpful and surprising ways.
